sections.title: Clock Town
sections.note: The first cycle, as a Deku Scrub.

items.name: Take back the Ocarina
items.area: Top of the Clock Tower, South Clock Town
items.howTo: In the first cycle, as a Deku: bring the Clock Town Stray Fairy (Laundry Pool) to the Fairy's Fountain in North Clock Town for magic, then climb the Clock Tower when its door opens at midnight on the Final Day. Hit the Skull Kid with a Deku bubble to make him drop the Ocarina, and play the Song of Time.
items.reward: Ocarina of Time, Song of Time; the Happy Mask Salesman then teaches the Song of Healing and the Deku Mask
items.notes: Everything else resets when the Song of Time takes you back to the Dawn of the First Day; the Ocarina, songs and masks stay.

sections.title: Temple Songs
sections.note: The song that opens each temple. Songs stay through the Song of Time, so each is learned once.

items.name: Sonata of Awakening
items.howTo: Get a Bottle from Kotake for the Red Potion to save Koume and earn the swamp boat ride, then cross to the Deku Palace and learn the Sonata of Awakening from the caged Monkey.

items.name: Goron Lullaby
items.howTo: Get the Lens of Truth (the cave Kaepora Gaebora leads you to past Mountain Village) and the Goron Mask (Darmani's grave). Learn the Goron Lullaby from the Goron Elder and his son in the Goron Shrine.

items.name: New Wave Bossa Nova
items.howTo: Get the Zora Mask from Mikau, then the Hookshot from the Pirates' Fortress. Bring all seven Zora Eggs (four in the fortress, three in Pinnacle Rock) to the Marine Research Lab tank to learn the New Wave Bossa Nova.
items.notes: The eggs only stay alive within the cycle, so the egg hunt is a one-cycle job.

items.name: Elegy of Emptiness
items.howTo: Get past the Road to Ikana's guard with Garo's or the Gibdo Mask and climb into Ikana Canyon with the Ice Arrows. Get the Mirror Shield Beneath the Well and beat Igos du Ikana in the Ancient Castle for the Elegy of Emptiness.

sections.title: Temples
sections.note: Each boss's Remains free one of the Four Giants. Remains, Heart Containers and the temple's item stay through the Song of Time; the temple's region goes back to its cursed state.

items.name: Woodfall Temple
items.howTo: Fly up to Woodfall as a Deku and play the Sonata of Awakening on the platform to raise the temple.
items.reward: Odolwa's Remains, a Heart Container and the Hero's Bow (in the temple); the Swamp Giant teaches the Oath to Order
items.notes: Boss: Odolwa, the Masked Jungle Warrior. Clearing it lifts the swamp's poison, which opens Koume's boat archery and the Deku Butler's race for the rest of that cycle.

items.name: Snowhead Temple
items.howTo: Play the Goron Lullaby to put the giant Goron on the Snowhead path to sleep, then climb to the temple.
items.reward: Goht's Remains, a Heart Container and the Fire Arrows (in the temple); spring comes to the mountains
items.notes: Boss: Goht, the Masked Mechanical Monster. Spring opens the Goron Race, the smithy and the thawed pond until the Song of Time.

items.name: Great Bay Temple
items.howTo: Play the New Wave Bossa Nova for Lulu at Zora Cape. The turtle carries you to the temple.
items.reward: Gyorg's Remains, a Heart Container and the Ice Arrows (in the temple); the sea clears
items.notes: Boss: Gyorg, the Gargantuan Masked Fish.

items.name: Stone Tower Temple
items.howTo: Use the Elegy of Emptiness to climb Stone Tower. Inside, the Light Arrows let you turn the temple upside down.
items.reward: Twinmold's Remains, a Heart Container and the Light Arrows (in the temple); Ikana's curse lifts
items.notes: Boss: Twinmold, the Giant Masked Insect, in the inverted temple; use the Giant's Mask.

items.name: Defeat Majora's Mask
items.howTo: With all four Remains, climb the Clock Tower at midnight on the Final Day and play the Oath to Order to call the Giants. Inside the Moon, talk to the child under the tree in Majora's Mask and face Majora.
items.notes: The ending shows a scene for each Bombers' Notebook story you finished. The Moon Children's trials (Pieces of Heart and the Fierce Deity's Mask) are optional.
